implementation: engine/rust/question_selection.rs select(): candidates already fresh/usable, deduplicate/sort, select weighted nonempty difficulty then uniformly within band via second SHA256 word. This reproduction uses UUID ordering rather than unknown future numeric entity IDs; thus counts are illustrative, reachability and cue preservation do not depend on ordering.
scenario: Fresh learner, requested difficulty has positive weight; all accepted records are eligible; 256 deterministic task seeds. Actual policy weights and learner history absent from captured inventory. Zero weight suppresses entire band; history can only remove members.
structural_result: Every accepted member has positive selection probability in a positive-weight band. All 5 batch members are easy_linear with both exponent signs; selection cannot introduce easy_constant. Interval copying succeeds on every tested surviving member of each affected template, so difficulty weighting/history cannot cure the within-template leak.
limitations: No live policy or learner history captured; no claim of exact future frequencies or IDs.
